The script operates only within the package directory and installs into standard system locations under `${pkgdir}`. No obfuscated code, network requests, or dangerous runtime operations are present.

While the package includes optional dependencies like `gnupg` and `firewalld` for enhanced functionality, their use is declarative and does not trigger automatic installation or execution. The maintainer follows Go packaging guidelines, and all operations are transparent and reproducible. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, remote code execution, or supply-chain tampering.
</details>
